newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia seen leading Finnish shares higher.
newsitem.headline: Nokia seen leading Finnish shares higher.

text.p: Overnight gains in Nokia and its U.S. rival Motorola's encouraging Q4 report together with the strong dollar and firm bonds were expected to boost Finnish shares on Friday, brokers said.
"We could hit a new life-high again," one broker said.
On Thursday, the Helsinki bourse closed slightly lower after hitting a 2,620.61 all-time high in intra-day trade Wednesday.
Nokia was expected to remain in focus after recent positive comments by several brokerages, and Motorola's Q4 report.
Nokia closed at about 295.70 markka in New York on Thursday, compared to its 292.50 markka close in Helsinki.
The strong dollar and the overall positive sentiment could help forestries slightly higher although U.S. paper stocks fell overnight, brokers said.
